articles.summary:

articles.title: ThreatBook Launches RedAgents AI Platform That Uses Multiple Hacking Agents to Find Security Flaws
articles.summary:

articles.title: U.S. Government Bans DeepSeek AI and Orders Federal Agencies to Remove All Related Tools
articles.summary:
The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop buying DeepSeek products and remove related technology from their IT systems. The action covers products from Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd., its affiliates, and third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek implementations. articles.title: Hackers Exploit Palo Alto VPN Flaw to Bypass MFA and Steal Credentials From VMware Disks
articles.summary:
Ransomware operators are exploiting a Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect VPN flaw to bypass multi-factor authentication and enter corporate networks. In one investigated case, attackers reached VMware management systems and stole credentials directly from a domain controller’s virtual disk, avoiding security tools running inside the virtual machine. articles.title: Hackers Hijack OVHcloud GitHub Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Compromise Rank Math PRO WordPress Plugin to Install Self-Rebuilding Backdoors
articles.summary:
